summary: First-finish smoke test on Osteon Web3 NFT qualification app. Backend: 14/14 core endpoints work (register idempotent, referral increments, login, get_user with attempts/cooldown, tasks, questions without correct_index, test submit with score/cooldown 429, leaderboard sorted, admin login + auth via X-Admin-Token, add/delete questions). Frontend: landing loads with all sections, AuthModal registers user & closes, wallet badge in navbar, tasks toggle & sync toast, qualification test starts and navigates questions, referral copy button present, leaderboard renders, /admin login with correct credentials shows Users/Questions tabs and Export button. No blocking issues.
passed: GET /api/ health
POST /api/register creates user with referral_code
POST /api/register idempotent for same wallet
POST /api/register with referred_by increments referrer.referral_count to 1
POST /api/login unknown wallet returns 404
GET /api/user/{wallet} returns allowed_attempts=2 (1+refs), attempts_remaining, cooldown_seconds
POST /api/tasks/complete updates tasks
GET /api/questions returns 15 questions, no correct_index leaked, pass_score=70, total=100
POST /api/test/submit computes score and returns qualified flag
POST /api/test/submit returns 429 during cooldown
GET /api/leaderboard sorted by referral_count desc, best_score desc
Admin login rejects wrong creds (401), accepts osteon_admin/BoneMaster206
Admin endpoints require X-Admin-Token (401 without, 200 with)
Admin add + delete question
Frontend landing loads, all data-testids resolve
AuthModal flow registers new user and closes modal, wallet badge visible
Tasks sync -> Tasks synced toast
Qualification test starts, radio options render, prev/next navigation works
Referral copy button and Leaderboard table render
/admin login with correct creds unlocks Users(3)/Questions(15) tabs and Export CSV button
notes: test_credentials.md matches backend .env (BoneMaster206). Admin password in server.py default fallback was BoneMaster206! but actual env overrides to BoneMaster206 so no impact.
